items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Equity must not fall below 4.5% of previous day's closing balance at any point. Resets daily at 17:00 NY Time. Static — does not trail. Hard breach = immediate closure without refund.

items.label: Max Overall Drawdown
items.detail: Equity must not fall below 9% of initial balance. Static for account lifetime. Example: $100K account → equity must never drop below $91,000.

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: 2 profitable days per phase AND before each payout. Profitable day = balance at 23:00 CET is ≥ 0.5% higher than previous day. Final day can be fast-tracked if target is reached and trades are closed.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: Trading permitted at all times. Unbalanced exploitation of high-impact news events is not permitted.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: No specific weekend hold rule stated for 2-Step accounts. Subject to general platform terms.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Triggered by daily or max drawdown violation. Account closed without refund. No recovery.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional
items.detail: Each breach of Notional Volume Limit = 1 strike. Challenge: must return to positive balance before reset allowed. 5 strikes = account closure. All strikes cleared upon reaching Funded Status.

items.label: Soft Breach — Funded
items.detail: Each strike reduces next payout cycle by 10%. 5 cumulative strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starting split on funded account. On-demand after completing 2 minimum profitable days.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: First payout on-demand after MPD met. Subsequent payouts available weekly.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: 100% challenge fee refunded on the 30th funded day if account is in profit.
